description:
`/Users/yann/bin/bw` symlinks to `/Users/yann/src/github.com/jallum/beadwork/bw`, a Mach-O binary built 2026-04-13 reporting **0.12.3**. `/Users/yann/bin` precedes `/etc/profiles/per-user/yann/bin` on PATH (positions 6 and 8), so this stale dev build shadows the nix-managed **0.13.0** from `toolbox.beadwork` for every interactive shell.

Consequences:
- `which bw` / `bw --version` misreport the installed version, which is what caused the duplicate upgrade tickets nix-9nf and nix-30k to be filed with different baselines.
- The repo declares beadwork in home-modules/default.nix:93, but that declaration is silently defeated on this machine.

Options: delete the symlink (the dev checkout can be run by path when needed), rebuild it from a current checkout, or reorder PATH so nix profiles win. Deleting is the cheapest and restores the declared state.

Note this is unmanaged machine state, not repo state — the fix is a one-off action unless the repo should be asserting PATH precedence for nix profiles.
title: Stale ~/bin/bw dev symlink shadows the nix-managed beadwork
